items.title: Heres what happened in crypto today

items.title: Crypto PACs report $2.7M spending blitz on House races as midterms loom
items.summary: With just 22 days until the US midterm elections, a crypto-aligned committee has announced another major ad expenditure to support pro-crypto candidates in 2026.

items.title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
items.summary: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.

items.title: Bitcoin miners face widening AI financing costs as lenders scrutinize deals
items.summary: The Bitcoin mining industry needs roughly $50 billion to complete planned AI infrastructure projects, with IREN, Riot Platforms and HIVE Digital facing major funding gaps.

items.title: Bitcoin drops 2.2% as Ukraine, Iran strikes send oil toward one-month high
items.summary: Bitcoin price action stayed rangebound after failing to sustain above $84,000 into the Wall Street open on rising oil prices.

items.title: XRP treasury Evernorths shares rise 5% at Nasdaq opening print
items.summary: Evernorths share price rose by 5% as investors welcomed the Nasdaq debut of the first pure-play XRP digital asset treasury.

items.title: Meta's New Muse Wonder Finally Puts Zuckerberg in the Frontier AI Race
items.summary: Meta's new flagship beats GPT-6 Astra and Claude on memory, legal and marathon coding tests, but independent rankings still put Anthropic's Opus 5.5 on top.

items.title: Ripple-Backed Evernorth Hits Nasdaq Holding 473 Million XRP Worth Far Less Than It Paid

items.title: Bitcoin Spooked? Crypto Fear and Greed Index Drops to Pre-Rally August Lows
items.summary: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index has dropped to 56 from an August peak of 82, as oil, bond yields, and ETF outflows hit Bitcoin in October.

items.title: CFTCs new crypto framework could face 2028 election deadline, says TD Cowen
items.summary: Newly proposed rules for leveraged and margined crypto trading may be too late as the 2028 election cycle looms, according to TD Cowen.

items.title: Binance launches AI trading tool after 150,000-user beta
items.summary: Binance rolled out Binance AI, a free generative-UI trading interface, to all English-language users after a beta with about 150,000 testers.

items.title: StoneX raises Securitize price target 50% as tokenized stock platform opens new revenue stream

items.title: DeFi Development grows SOL holdings 12% as CHAD hits record highs
items.summary: DFDV added 22,070 SOL last week, lifting holdings to 2.59 million SOL, as its CHAD preferred stock hit record highs despite a selloff.

items.title: Bitmine adds 12,532 ETH as Tom Lee flags potential largest-ever crypto bull market
items.summary: Bitmine (BMNR) added 12,532 ETH last week, lifting its Ethereum treasury to 6.03 million tokens, or 4.9% of supply, with 84% staked.
